prompt: We're launching v2.0 of 'Meridian', our data-pipeline product. I want a hero/poster-grade WLILO SVG for the launch page (full luxury treatment — gemstone buttons for 'Get started' and 'Read the docs') plus a small matching CSS snippet with the WLILO variables so our frontend can style the surrounding page consistently.
assertions: Both deliverables exist: an SVG file and a CSS file
SVG parses as XML with viewBox, <title> and <desc>

Gemstone CTA construction: both button labels ('Get started', 'Read the docs') present, sapphire gradient hexes (#1e5aad/#60a5fa/#123a74) present for the primary CTA, and ruby is NOT used for either CTA (ruby = destructive semantics)
Full-luxe texture: at least one <pattern> element (grain or brushed metal) or the 5-stop brushedMetal gradient
CSS defines at least 5 --wlilo-* custom properties with values drawn from the WLILO token tables
CSS uses semantic classes (e.g. .wlilo-*) rather than element inline styles
